how_admission_is_observed.why_not_the_url: A refused principal signs in, the login page pushes to /workspace, the shell redirects back to /login, and the login page — holding a valid session — pushes again. Sampling that loop returns whichever side the sample lands on: in one run cert.frontdesk sampled /login and cert.finviewer, whose grants are just as portal-less, sampled /workspace. Same refusal, two answers. page.goto is not part of the loop: the server either renders the shell or answers 307.

cert_stack_drift_found.state: active in permission_definitions on the shared certification database, granted to nobody, inserted at runtime 2026-09-10, seeded by NO migration in this tree.
cert_stack_drift_found.evidence: 20260911110000_attendance_capture_scope_policy.sql records that the attendance lane deliberately did NOT put that capability in the catalog, because 'permissions are additive and union across roles, so a narrowing permission would make adding a role reduce authority'. It is residue from an approach they abandoned.
cert_stack_drift_found.consequence: A reproduced catalog-completeness guard aborts on it, and no edit to a migration can make it true. 20260911140000 therefore reproduces only the guards that read the FUNCTION; the guards that read the DATABASE stay with 20260910183000, which owns the completeness contract.
